VivSoft is a technology company that develops secure software solutions for federal agencies, including the United States Air Force. The Front-End Developer will build and maintain responsive, accessible web applications for cybersecurity and vulnerability management platforms, integrate enterprise data and authentication services, and collaborate with cross-functional Agile teams.
Artificial Intelligence (AI)

Responsibilities
Develop and maintain responsive, accessible user interfaces using Vue 3, React, and Angular
Migrate and consolidate functionality between existing front-end applications while maintaining a consistent user experience
Translate wireframes, mockups, and business requirements into production-ready solutions
Build dashboards and visualizations using tables, filters, and charts to display vulnerability and security data
Integrate front-end applications with REST APIs and authentication services
Implement OIDC-based authentication and secure token management
Apply front-end security best practices, including CSP and XSS prevention
Ensure compliance with Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards
Develop unit and component tests and support automated UI testing efforts
Participate in Agile ceremonies, code reviews, Git workflows, and CI/CD processes

Required
Must possess an active Secret Clearance
0-3 years of professional front-end development experience
Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript development
Experience with Vue 3 (Composition API), React, or Angular, with the ability and willingness to work across multiple front-end frameworks
Experience using component libraries such as Vuetify, Material UI (MUI), or Angular Material, along with SCSS for styling
Knowledge of client-side state management solutions, including Pinia, Redux Toolkit, or similar frameworks
Experience consuming and integrating REST APIs using Axios or Fetch
Experience writing unit tests using Vitest, Jest, or similar testing frameworks
Proficiency with Git version control and GitLab merge request workflows
Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, and front-end development best practices
Preferred
Experience with Vite for modern front-end development and build optimization
Experience with Cypress for end-to-end and component testing of web applications
Knowledge of data visualization tools and libraries, including D3.js and other charting frameworks
Understanding of front-end security best practices, including Content Security Policy (CSP) and secure web application development
Familiarity with Section 508 and WCAG accessibility standards to ensure compliance and inclusive user experiences
Experience using Docker for local development, testing, and containerized application environments
CompTIA Security+ certification
willingness to obtain it to meet DoD 8140 compliance requirements
Prior experience supporting DoD, USAF, or Federal Government programs
Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and DevSecOps practices
